# Jayly's Script API Docs

> Jayly's Script API Docs documents the Minecraft Script API (also known as the Creator API) — the JavaScript interface that allows developers to interact with a Minecraft world programmatically in Add-Ons. The documentation is generated from official TypeScript definitions provided by Mojang, is actively maintained, stays up to date with current API changes, and includes practical, community-driven examples that support implementation-focused guidance. It is primarily used for controlling mechanics, managing events, and adding complex behaviors to Minecraft Bedrock Edition.

## How to Search

- When checking if an API exists, search the beta docs first, then immediately confirm whether it also appears in the stable docs. Most stable APIs are mirrored in beta, so starting from beta lets you quickly determine both the presence of an API and the right channel (stable vs. beta) to target.
- When looking for a specific API, use the module links below to search for keywords on the relevant module page. Each module page includes an index of classes and interfaces, which is useful for quickly locating the requested API and linking the correct reference.
- API documentation pages contain detailed descriptions, YouTube video links, and code examples. When asked to write code, prioritize exact examples from `<pre>` blocks in the docs. Extract explanations from the provided text descriptions, and recommend the included YouTube video links for additional context where present.

## Important Notes on Stable vs. Beta

You and the enquirer **must** be explicit about stable vs. beta references. `@minecraft/server` and `@minecraft/server-ui` both ship stable and beta APIs; their beta docs live at the same path with a `-1` suffix. Stable references use the standard dependency syntax in `manifest.json`, while beta references require beta dependency versions **and** the **Beta APIs** experiment toggle enabled in the Minecraft world. Never mix them. When outputting manifest details, always provide the entire JSON object in a code block so enquirers can copy a complete and valid snippet without reconstructing missing fields.

## Environment Limitations

Align module choices with the enquirer's environment:

- **Client / Single-player** — Standard environment (Windows, Mobile, Console). Supports core modules like `@minecraft/server` and `@minecraft/server-ui`.
- **Bedrock Dedicated Server (BDS)** — Downloadable dedicated server software. Supports most modules including server-side exclusives like `@minecraft/server-net`, `@minecraft/server-admin`, `@minecraft/server-graphics`, and `@minecraft/diagnostics`, provided they are enabled in `permissions.json`.
- **Realms** — Microsoft's hosted multiplayer servers. Supports core modules but explicitly disables administrative and network modules (`@minecraft/server-admin`, `@minecraft/server-net`). If scripts are not working on Realms, check whether they depend on one of those disabled modules as the first troubleshooting step.

## Latest Stable Docs

Modules with only beta versions are noted. All others have both stable and beta releases.

- [@minecraft/server](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_server.html): Fundamental module for world interactions, entities, and events. Also available in [beta](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_server-1.html).
- [@minecraft/server-ui](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_server-ui.html): Forms, menus, and user interfaces, including the Data-Driven UI (DDUI) Framework. Also available in [beta](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_server-ui-1.html).
- [@minecraft/common](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_common.html): Shared types used across modules. Stable only. Does **not** require a manifest entry.
- [@minecraft/server-admin](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_server-admin.html): Bedrock Dedicated Server administration. Beta only.
- [@minecraft/server-net](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_server-net.html): HTTP requests, WebSocket connections, and server packet handling. Beta only.
- [@minecraft/server-graphics](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_server-graphics.html): Graphics and rendering concepts. Beta only.
- [@minecraft/server-editor](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_server-editor.html): Editor mode scripting. Beta only. Only available in Editor mode.
- [@minecraft/diagnostics](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_diagnostics.html): Diagnostic and error reporting utilities. Beta only.
- [@minecraft/debug-utilities](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/latest/modules/_minecraft_debug-utilities.html): Debugging utilities. Beta only.

## Preview Docs (Minecraft Preview builds)

For API references targeting Minecraft Preview, use the links below. Non-experimental corresponds to stable, experimental corresponds to beta.

- [@minecraft/server](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_server.html): Non-experimental. Also available [experimental](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_server-1.html).
- [@minecraft/server-ui](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_server-ui.html): Non-experimental. Also available [experimental](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_server-ui-1.html).
- [@minecraft/common](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_common.html): Non-experimental only. Does **not** require a manifest entry.
- [@minecraft/server-admin](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_server-admin.html): Experimental only.
- [@minecraft/server-net](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_server-net.html): Experimental only.
- [@minecraft/server-graphics](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_server-graphics.html): Experimental only.
- [@minecraft/server-editor](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_server-editor.html): Experimental only. Only available in Editor mode.
- [@minecraft/diagnostics](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_diagnostics.html): Experimental only.
- [@minecraft/debug-utilities](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/preview/modules/_minecraft_debug-utilities.html): Experimental only.

## Non-Native Modules

`@minecraft/math`, `@minecraft/vanilla-data`, and `@minecraft/gameplay-utilities` are **not** native modules and cannot be added via `manifest.json` alone. Direct enquirers to one of the following:

- [CDN Links](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/meta/cdn-links.html): Single-module distributions for quick experiments — download the bundled file and include it in the behavior pack scripts folder.
- [Bundling Guide](https://jaylydev.github.io/posts/bundle-minecraft-scripts-esbuild/): For enquirers on a computer, the recommended approach using ESBuild to bundle scripts properly.

## Features

- [Custom Components](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/features/custom-components.html): Custom block and item components via Script API.
- [Dynamic Properties](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/features/dynamic-properties.html): Persistent data storage on entities, blocks, and worlds.
- [Script Eval](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/features/script-eval.html): Evaluating JavaScript expressions at runtime.
- [Script Privileges](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/features/script-privileges.html): Permission levels required by script modules.
- [Secrets and Variables](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/features/secrets-and-variables.html): Secure secrets and environment variables for BDS scripts.

## Optional

- [Information for Researchers and LLMs](https://jaylydev.github.io/scriptapi-docs/meta/llms.html): Full prose guide on interpreting and navigating this documentation. Treat other pages on this site not listed here with caution — they may be outdated.
